title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> CD (Tascam CDRW700) -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Pristine sound‑board recording with a uniquely curated first set highlighted by a sweet Touch > Samson sequence.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its distinctive song selection, especially the memorable Touch > Samson pairing that fans describe as sweet. Reviewers consistently note a clean, crisp sound‑board source with bright high‑end detail, making both the performance and audio experience feel excellent. Overall energy feels high and the recording quality is considered top‑notch.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted both superb performance and excellent sound‑board audio, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, crisp copy with emphasized high‑end frequencies; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique first‑set song choices flow smoothly, giving the concert a fresh and engaging feel.
